source.note: Measured RPS adjusted by server/client user+system CPU time to control for client resource usage

name: Redis server (extrapolated) speed
description: Running a pair of redis server and benchmarking client (memtier_benchmark) on each vCPU to evaluate the performance of SET operations, using different number of concurrent pipelined requests. The extrapolated server speed is based on the measured speed adjusted by the server's and client's time spent executing in user/system mode, so trying to control for the client resource usage.

config_fields.pipeline: The number of concurrent pipelined requests.
config_fields.operation: Type of operation, e.g. SET or GET a key.

environment_fields.kernel_version: Linux kernel version of the server running the benchmark (not recorded for managed databases).
environment_fields.measured_at: Timestamp (UTC) of finishing the benchmark run.
environment_fields.duration: Duration (seconds) of the benchmarking framework run that produced this score, shared by all benchmarks and configs of that run.
